description: Find software products by task or name, with optional filters. Returns compact rows (id, entry price, cost-trap ids, pricing date). Ranking is text relevance only, never commission.

avoid_cost_traps.description: Cost-trap ids to leave out, as shown in the cost_traps field of search results.
avoid_cost_traps.title: Avoid Cost Traps

category.description: Category name exactly as returned by list_categories, e.g. 'Marketing'. Leave empty for all categories.
category.title: Category

cursor.description: Offset for the next page: 0 for the first page, then the next_cursor value from the previous result.
cursor.title: Cursor

free_plan.description: true to return only products with a confirmed free plan, false to exclude them; leave empty for both.
free_plan.title: Free Plan

has_cost_rules.description: true to return only products with machine-readable price rules (needed by estimate_cost and cost_at_growth).
has_cost_rules.title: Has Cost Rules

max_price_usd_month.description: Highest entry price to include, in US dollars per month. Leave empty for no limit.
max_price_usd_month.title: Max Price Usd Month

query.description: What the user wants to do or the product name, in plain words, e.g. 'invoicing for freelancers'. Leave empty to browse.
query.title: Query

name: search_products
